title: Nahum Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Nahum 3: woe to the bloody city, the comparison with No-Amon, and the merchants like the stars.

questions.text: What is the bloody city said to be full of?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:1 says woe to the bloody city, which is all full of lies and robbery.

questions.text: The alluring prostitute is called the mistress of what?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:4 calls her the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will lift over her face?
questions.explanation: In Nahum 3:5 Yahweh of Armies says he will lift her skirts over her face and show the nations her nakedness.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will throw on her?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:6 says he will throw abominable filth on her, make her vile and set her as a spectacle.

questions.text: What will those who look at her say?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:7 says all who look at her will flee from her and say, "Nineveh is laid waste!"

questions.text: Which city is she asked to compare herself with?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:8 asks whether she is better than No-Amon, which was situated among the rivers.

questions.text: Who are named as the helpers of that city?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:9 says Put and Libya were her helpers.

questions.text: What will her fortresses be like, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:12 says all her fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs, which fall when shaken.

answers.text: Fig trees with the first-ripe figs

questions.text: Her merchants are said to be more numerous than what?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:16 says she has increased her merchants more than the stars of the skies.

questions.text: Which king is told that his shepherds slumber?
questions.explanation: Nahum 3:18 says the shepherds of the king of Assyria slumber and his people are scattered on the mountains.
